label: MC-005
note: Hardcoded API key committed in source: the private const ApiKey literal will be stored in git history and visible to anyone with repo read access, enabling unauthorized use of the external payment service.

known_true_positive.title: Hardcoded production API key committed in source
known_true_positive.why_it_matters: The live payment API key is a string constant, so it is stored in git history and readable by anyone with repository access, allowing unauthorized charges. Load it from configuration or a secret store.
